chain_steps.detail: Notary seal on the document itself (POAs: over the principal signature, never on a separate paper). Arabic-only docs: use an Arabic-knowing notary or a one-page Arabic+English POA. County pre-step per issuing state (NY confirmed).
chain_steps.title: Notarization (on-document seal)

chain_steps.detail: Embassy rule in its own English: the consulate only accepts authentication and certification from the Secretary of State; apostilles are NOT accepted. Per-state product name/fee unverified.
chain_steps.title: Secretary of State Certificate of Authentication — NEVER apostille

chain_steps.detail: Mandatory for commercial, court, and marriage/divorce instruments. Personal-doc need is V-6. See the usdos pack.
chain_steps.title: USDOS authentication (conditional)

chain_steps.detail: Educational certificates and US academic-track docs: Cultural Bureau first, then final consulate legalization ($47). Whether this applies in all consulate jurisdictions or DC-only is V-17.
chain_steps.title: Cultural & Educational Bureau pre-step (educational docs)

chain_steps.detail: Route by the state that ISSUED/AUTHENTICATED the document, not where the customer lives. DC accepts ONLY DE, FL, GA, MD, NC, SC, VA, DC, WV.
chain_steps.title: Embassy/consulate legalization — routed by issuing state

chain_steps.detail: Stated identically on all three DC legalization pages. Return envelope must be pre-paid, pre-addressed, with tracking; Express/Certified strongly advised. Non-compliant packaging sits pending and unprocessed. Prepaid labels for this hop must be USPS.
chain_steps.title: Consulate mail hop: USPS ONLY — FedEx/UPS refused

observations.statement: OBSERVED (official jurisdiction map): DC serves DE, FL, GA, MD, NC, SC, VA, DC, WV.
OBSERVED (official jurisdiction map): NY serves CT, ME, MA, NH, NJ, OH, PA, PR, RI, VT, NY.
OBSERVED (official jurisdiction map): Chicago serves IL, IN, IA, KY, MI, MN, NE, ND, SD, WI.
OBSERVED (official jurisdiction map, re-confirmed on LA site): LA serves AK, AZ, CA, ID, HI, MT, NV, OR, WA, WY, UT.
OBSERVED (official jurisdiction map): Houston serves AL, AR, CO, KS, LA, MS, MO, NM, OK, TN, TX.
OBSERVED (official page): DC post at 3521 International Ct NW, Washington DC 20008.
OBSERVED (official page): NY post at 866 UN Plaza, Suite 586, NY 10017.
OBSERVED (official page): Chicago post at 180 N Michigan Ave, Suite 1150, Chicago IL 60601. Directories list 500 N Michigan #1900, 60611 (C-4).
OBSERVED (official page): LA post at 6300 Wilshire Blvd, Suite 1890, LA CA 90048. Directories list 4929 Wilshire Suite 300, 90010 (C-1).
OBSERVED (official page): Houston post at 5718 Westheimer St, Suite 1350, Houston TX 77057. One directory lists 1000 West Loop N #200, 77055 (C-5).
OBSERVED (official page): DC 202-966-6342, consulate@egyptembassy.net.
OBSERVED (official page): NY 212-759-7120, egyptnyc@gmail.com.
OBSERVED (official page): Chicago 312-332-7210/7214, consulateofegyptchicago@gmail.com. No official website found (V-16).
OBSERVED (official page): LA 323-933-9700, egyconsulatela@egyconsulatela.com, www.egyconsulatela.com.
OBSERVED (official page): Houston 713-961-4915/4916, consulateofegyptinhouston@gmail.com. No official website found (V-16).

OBSERVED (official DC pages): personal $47/doc; commercial $132/doc; pet $132; signature certification $47 non-commercial / $132 commercial; translation $47. CONTRADICTED by the LA-hosted 'unified fee schedule effective 1/3/2026' ($42 non-commercial, $52 translation — C-2).

OBSERVED (official DC pages): cashier's check only from a US bank payable to 'Consulate of Egypt' (mail); cash in person; NO personal checks, NO money orders; commercial checks must stay valid >1 month after receipt.

CONTRADICTION C-3 (do not publish): a snippet of NY's own commercial page stated $55/doc payable by cash, USPS money order, or cashier's — contradicting DC ($132, no money orders) and the unified schedule ($132). The page now 404s.
OBSERVED (official DC pages): walk-ins Mon-Fri 9:30am-12:30pm, pickup 3:00-4:00pm (pet docs same-day); mailed personal 10 business days; commercial (walked or mailed) 5 business days.
OBSERVED (official DC pages, wording varies): personal/commercial say 'USPS Priority Mail envelope (approx. 11x8.5)'; signatures page says 'letter-sized USPS envelope'. Single canonical spec is V-18.

OBSERVED (official DC pages): educational certificates go first to the Egyptian Cultural & Educational Bureau, 1303 New Hampshire Ave NW, Washington DC 20036, 202-296-4042, then final consulate legalization ($47).

OBSERVED (official DC page): pets — vet health letter with USDA APHIS authentication and dry embossed seal; certificate valid ONLY 14 days from issuance, so 10-business-day mail processing must fit inside; $132. Handbook must show a countdown warning.

OBSERVED (official signatures page): POA/declaration mail route — sign before notary (ID data in POA text), SOS, USDOS if commercial, consulate with bank-accepted check + ID copy + tracked self-addressed return. Foreigners' sale/bank POAs: NO mail, in-person only. US-passport ID forces in-person. Cancellations never at the embassy.
